_note: Clusters group the skills for people: a short list of named groups instead of 800 names. A skill goes to the first cluster that matches, in this order, and is listed as 'also in' up to two more. A cluster matches a skill when the skill's category is one of `categories` (if given) and its name matches `name_rx` (if given, a regular expression). A cluster with only `categories` takes every skill of those categories that no earlier cluster took. Clusters of your own go in clusters.json in the hive's data folder (sfp_hive.py cluster-add).
